parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 Which man is the girl’s French teacher?

Girl: Do you know who Mr Perry is, my French teacher?

Boy: I don’t think so. Is he the one with the beard and glasses?

Girl: That’s Mr Hamswell, the maths teacher. No, my French teacher hasn’t got a beard, but he wears glasses – really small ones.

Boy: Oh yes, I know. He helps with our hockey practice sometimes. He’s really funny!

2 What is the boy going to do?

Mum: Oh, Jim! I don’t think you can wear a football shirt to play tennis, can you?

Boy: It’s fine, Mum, everyone does.

Mum: Oh, OK then. Well come on, I’ll give you a lift to the sports club, because it’s getting late. If I don’t, you’ll have to run to get there on time!

Boy: Oh Mum, sorry, can you wait a minute? I haven’t got my racket.

3 Which bike was the woman riding?

Girl: I’ve just seen a woman riding a really strange bike!

Boy: Was it with big fat wheels?

Girl: No, one wheel was bigger than the other.

Boy: Oh, you mean the front one was small?

Girl: The front one was much bigger than the back one. And the seat is above it! Really high up. Probably very difficult to ride!

4 Which game is the boy playing?

Mum: What game are you playing?

Boy: It’s called Yesterday. I’m the good guy. This dinosaur’s the bad guy. I have to catch him. Then we can become friends. And I can ride him like a horse and we race across the island.

Mum: Oh, you’re not playing the game with cars today?

Boy: Actually, I like that better. I’ll play that car race game tomorrow.

5 How are the people going to travel?

Boy: How are we going to get to the cinema? I don’t really want to walk if it’s going to rain.

Girl: Well, a taxi’s expensive.

Boy: And if we go by bus, we have to change buses, and that takes ages. Or maybe we should just walk actually.

Girl: OK, that sounds alright. Are you ready?

Boy: Yeah. Let’s go.
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Jemima: Hi Lisa, it’s Jemima. It’s awesome that you’re coming to stay with me for the night, so here are some details. OK, I’ve invited you to come on November 22nd. I hope that’s still OK. So, when can we meet? Well, I have basketball practice until five past three. So let’s say at three fifteen, OK? And we need to meet somewhere cars can wait, so not the station, because it’s too busy. There’s a chemist next to the park – can you wait for me there? My mum’ll pick us up. I’ll give you her phone number: it’s 079059654double3. You can call her if you need to. What else? Oh – don’t forget your toothbrush this time. I’m not lending you mine! But you can borrow a towel when you’re here. Oh – and maybe we can watch a movie. There’s one called Kazoom. I’ll spell that so you can look online and tell me if you want to see it: K-A-Z-double O-M. Let me know what you think. Bye!
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Dad: Olivia, I had an email about your class visit.

Olivia: Yeah, to a car factory.

Dad: In November, the second, I think.

Olivia: No, that’s a Saturday, that means the third is a Sunday, so it’s on the fourth. That’s a school day.

Dad: Oh that’s right.

Olivia: Yeah.

Dad: But the email didn’t say if we pay for it or not.

Olivia: Oh.

Dad: … although they did include the factory’s address, with start and finish times. Don’t worry, I’ll find out.

Olivia: OK. I was surprised that we’re visiting a factory. I mean, the teacher loves museums, that’s where we normally go on trips. A factory trip is unusual for us, but this term’s topic is cars.

Dad: It’ll be fun, seeing the latest cars!

Olivia: Well maybe for some people. But me, I can’t wait to see one that was in that action movie we saw.

Dad: Oh yes, when it was racing against a motorbike.

Olivia: Exactly!

Dad: I’m sure they’ll tell you if you can use your camera in the factory. If they say ‘Does anyone have any questions?’, do ask something! It’s not very good if no one says anything!
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a girl and her father talking about what’s on TV. What have they forgotten?

Girl: Dad, do you remember this film?

Dad: I was just thinking about that. I think so, but I’m not sure.

Girl: Me neither. If we have seen it, we’ll probably remember soon. I certainly recognise the main actor. That’s Mark Smith.

Dad: Maybe because you’ve seen him in something else. Shall we just watch it anyway? It’s only two hours long and I don’t mind seeing it. Well, or seeing it again!

17 You will hear a boy talking to his mother about his homework. What does she think he should do?

Boy: Oh, I’ve got so much homework, it’s unbelievable!

Mum: Well, if you know which homework you need to hand in to the teacher first, why don’t you complete that immediately? And after you’ve done that, give yourself a break and have some time off.

Boy: OK, that sounds sensible I suppose.

Mum: Anything less urgent can be done another day.

18 You will hear a girl telling her classmate about a cake she made. What was the problem with the cake?

Girl: I thought I’d make a cake. Mum has showed me how to use the oven loads of times. I mixed everything up, flour, sugar, eggs, lemons, you know. Then I put it in the oven to bake, but the thing is I didn’t take it out soon enough. So, it looked a tiny bit burnt. It didn’t matter though, the taste was fine!

19 You will hear a boy who has just watched a video of himself. What was he surprised about?

Boy: In geography, we all gave a talk, and I just watched the video of me.

Mum: Was it strange, seeing yourself onscreen?

Boy: Not really, but I had no idea I was talking so quickly. The teacher said that, to explain things better, I should speak slowly and clearly.

Mum: Well, you can try to do that next time!

20 You will hear two classmates talking about a school play. Why doesn’t the boy want to be in the play?

Girl: Didn’t you want to be in the school play again Jonas? I thought you liked acting!

Boy: Yeah, I do. It’s just that all my friends are into different stuff. None of them’ll be in it. That’s why I decided not to.

Girl: Right. For me, being in a play just involves too much time.

Boy: Actually, it’s only once a week.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Dad: Have you got any homework, Katie?

Katie: Lots. For history, I need to remember some dates for a test.

Dad: OK. Any geography to do?

Katie: Yeah. You know how rivers don’t stay exactly the same all the time. They get wider. Or deeper.

Dad: Oh!

Katie: We have to find out how that happens.

Dad: Sounds interesting.

Katie: Yeah, I guess. And maths – the teacher’s just emailed us about that.

Dad: Yeah?

Katie: In class, we started doing ten maths questions from a sheet. We need to do the ones that we didn’t complete in class.

Dad: Oh, I see.

Katie: The Spanish teacher has asked us to email her in Spanish about a famous place.

Dad: What, like somewhere you’ve visited?

Katie: Exactly.

Dad: Do you have any biology homework?

Katie: Yeah. We’ve finished studying trees, and now we’re doing flowers. And we need to draw the inside of one.

Dad: Showing lots of detail?

Katie: Yeah. And for art …

Dad: Let me guess – draw a picture of something?

Katie: Actually it’s different. There’s a famous artist that we have to find out about. And next term, there’s a class trip to a museum to look at her paintings.

explanations.p1q1: 男孩猜老师是不是"Is he the one with the beard and glasses?"，女孩否定并说"That’s Mr Hamswell, the maths teacher. No, my French teacher hasn’t got a beard, but he wears glasses – really small ones."——留胡子的是数学老师 Hamswell，法语老师没有胡子，但戴一副很小的眼镜，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q2: 妈妈说"I don’t think you can wear a football shirt to play tennis, can you?"，说明男孩正准备去打网球；男孩又让妈妈等一下，因为"I haven’t got my racket."，球拍进一步印证他要去打网球，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩猜是不是"big fat wheels"，被女孩否定；女孩说"The front one was much bigger than the back one. And the seat is above it! Really high up."——前轮比后轮大得多，座位高高装在前轮上方，与 B 图老式自行车一致，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q4: 男孩说"It’s called Yesterday. I’m the good guy."，他要捉住恐龙、和它成为朋友，还能骑着恐龙赛跑；妈妈问是不是在玩汽车游戏，男孩说"Actually, I like that better. I’ll play that car race game tomorrow."——赛车游戏是明天才玩，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩说"Well, a taxi’s expensive."，男孩说坐公交"we have to change buses, and that takes ages"，最后提议"Or maybe we should just walk actually."，女孩同意，因此选择 A。（官方 Key 误印为 B，但 B 图是出租车，与文稿明确矛盾，按文稿取 A。）
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 3:15。Jemima 说自己篮球训练要到三点过五分才结束，"I have basketball practice until five past three. So let’s say at three fifteen, OK?"，所以约在 3:15 见面。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 chemist。Jemima 说要找一处汽车能等的地方，"so not the station, because it’s too busy"，接着说"There’s a chemist next to the park – can you wait for me there?"，即约在公园旁边的药店（chemist）等她。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 07905965433。Jemima 留妈妈电话时说"I’ll give you her phone number: it’s 079059654double3."，其中 double 3 表示末尾连续两个 3，连起来就是 07905965433。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 toothbrush。Jemima 提醒"Oh – don’t forget your toothbrush this time. I’m not lending you mine!"，要带的东西是牙刷；她还说了毛巾可以借用，不用带。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 Kazoom。Jemima 提议看电影："There’s one called Kazoom. I’ll spell that so you can look online"，并逐字母拼出"K-A-Z-double O-M"，即电影名 Kazoom。
explanations.p3q1: 爸爸以为参观在 11 月 2 日，Olivia 纠正说"No, that’s a Saturday, that means the third is a Sunday, so it’s on the fourth. That’s a school day."——2 日是周六、3 日是周日，参观定在 4 日那个上学日，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: 爸爸说"But the email didn’t say if we pay for it or not."，即邮件没提到参观是否要付费；他还说邮件里其实有地址和起止时间（"they did include the factory’s address, with start and finish times"），因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q3: Olivia 说"I was surprised that we’re visiting a factory. I mean, the teacher loves museums, that’s where we normally go on trips."——老师最喜欢博物馆，平时出游都去博物馆，所以这次去工厂让她很意外；并非老师觉得参观无聊，且这学期主题正好是汽车（"this term’s topic is cars"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q4: 爸爸说能看到最新款的车，但 Olivia 说"But me, I can’t wait to see one that was in that action movie we saw."，爸爸补充"Oh yes, when it was racing against a motorbike."——她迫不及待想看的是在那部动作片里出现过的那辆车，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q5: 爸爸说"If they say ‘Does anyone have any questions?’, do ask something! It’s not very good if no one says anything!"——如果厂里的人问有没有问题，一定要开口提问；相机能不能用要等厂方告知，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q1: 女孩说"I certainly recognise the main actor. That’s Mark Smith."，爸爸说"Maybe because you’ve seen him in something else."——女孩大概是在别的片子里见过这位演员，把别的片的演员错当成本片主演，两人其实记不清这部片主演的名字；对话没提结局和上次观看时间，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q2: 妈妈建议先弄清要先交哪份作业，"why don’t you complete that immediately?"，做完之后再"give yourself a break and have some time off"——先立刻完成要交给老师的那部分作业，做完之后再休息，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q3: 女孩说"I didn’t take it out soon enough. So, it looked a tiny bit burnt."——蛋糕没有及时从烤箱里取出来，看起来有点糊；她还补充"It didn’t matter though, the taste was fine!"，味道其实还好，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q4: 男孩说看自己的视频时"I had no idea I was talking so quickly."，老师建议他以后"I should speak slowly and clearly"，可见让他意外的是自己说话那么快，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩说"It’s just that all my friends are into different stuff. None of them’ll be in it. That’s why I decided not to."——朋友们兴趣各不相同、都不会参演，这才是他不参加的原因；“太花时间”是女孩的理由，男孩说"Actually, it’s only once a week."，因此选择 A。
explanations.p5q1: Katie 说河流"don’t stay exactly the same all the time. They get wider. Or deeper."，河流一直在变化，他们要"We have to find out how that happens."——查明河流如何变宽、变深，即研究事物如何变化，因此选 E。
explanations.p5q2: Katie 说"In class, we started doing ten maths questions from a sheet. We need to do the ones that we didn’t complete in class."——课上发了一张十道题的练习，没做完的要课后完成，即完成练习，因此选 F。
explanations.p5q3: Katie 说"The Spanish teacher has asked us to email her in Spanish about a famous place."——西班牙语老师要求用西语给她写邮件，介绍一个著名的地方，即写一封电子邮件，因此选 A。
explanations.p5q4: 生物课现在学花，Katie 说"we’re doing flowers. And we need to draw the inside of one."，爸爸还追问是不是"Showing lots of detail?"——要画出一朵花的内部结构并展示细节，即画一幅画，因此选 D。
explanations.p5q5: 爸爸猜美术作业又是"draw a picture of something?"，Katie 说"Actually it’s different. There’s a famous artist that we have to find out about."，下学期还要去博物馆看她的画——不是画画，而是了解一位著名画家，即了解一个人物，因此选 H。

uncertain: p4q17: 文本层引导行原作 “What does she think he should so?”，结合上下文与 official-data 题干判读转写为 “What does she think he should do?”
